title: The Temple Dedicated

questions.question: Where was the scroll found containing Cyrus's decree?
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:2 (ESV): "And in Ecbatana, the citadel that is in the province of Media, a scroll was found..."

questions.question: What did Darius order Tattenai and his associates to do?
options: Keep away and let the work alone
questions.correctAnswer: Keep away and let the work alone
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:6-7 (ESV): "...keep away. Let the work on this house of God alone..."

questions.question: Who was to pay for the rebuilding expenses?
options: The royal revenue from the tribute of the province
questions.correctAnswer: The royal revenue from the tribute of the province
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:8 (ESV): "...the cost is to be paid to these men in full and without delay from the royal revenue..."

questions.question: What was the penalty for altering the specific edict of Darius?
options: A beam pulled from his house and he impaled on it, and his house made a dunghill
questions.correctAnswer: A beam pulled from his house and he impaled on it, and his house made a dunghill
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:11 (ESV): "...a beam shall be pulled out of his house, and he shall be impaled on it, and his house shall be made a dunghill..."

questions.question: When was the house of God finished?
options: On the third day of the month of Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of Darius
questions.correctAnswer: On the third day of the month of Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of Darius
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:15 (ESV): "And this house was finished on the third day of the month of Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king."

questions.question: How many bulls were offered at the dedication?
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:17 (ESV): "And they offered at the dedication of this house of God 100 bulls..."

questions.question: How many male goats were offered as a sin offering?
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:17 (ESV): "...and for a sin offering for all Israel 12 male goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel."

questions.question: What feast did they keep with joy for seven days?
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:22 (ESV): "And they kept the Feast of Unleavened Bread seven days with joy..."

questions.question: Why specifically did they celebrate the Passover on the fourteenth day?
options: For the priests and the Levites had purified themselves together; all of them were clean
questions.correctAnswer: For the priests and the Levites had purified themselves together; all of them were clean
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:20 (ESV): "For the priests and the Levites had purified themselves together; all of them were clean."

questions.question: Whose heart had the LORD turned to them to aid them?
options: The king of Assyria (referring to Darius, king of Persia)
questions.correctAnswer: The king of Assyria (referring to Darius, king of Persia)
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:22 (ESV): "...and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria to them, so that he aided them..."

questions.question: Which three kings' decrees are mentioned as authority for the building?
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:14 (ESV): "...according to the decree of Cyrus and Darius and Artaxerxes king of Persia."

questions.question: What specific needs were to be given to the priests day by day?
options: Young bulls, rams, sheep, wheat, salt, wine, and oil
questions.correctAnswer: Young bulls, rams, sheep, wheat, salt, wine, and oil
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:9 (ESV): "And whatever is needed—young bulls, rams, or sheep for burnt offerings... wheat, salt, wine, or oil..."

questions.question: Why were these offerings to be given to the God of heaven?
options: That they may offer pleasing sacrifices... and pray for the life of the king and his sons
questions.correctAnswer: That they may offer pleasing sacrifices... and pray for the life of the king and his sons
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:10 (ESV): "that they may offer pleasing sacrifices to the God of heaven and pray for the life of the king and his sons."

questions.question: How did Tattenai execute the decree?
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:13 (ESV): "...did with all diligence what Darius the king had ordered."

questions.question: Who ate the Passover lamb?
options: The people of Israel who had returned... and everyone who had joined them and separated himself from the uncleanness of the peoples
questions.correctAnswer: The people of Israel who had returned... and everyone who had joined them and separated himself from the uncleanness of the peoples
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:21 (ESV): "It was eaten by the people of Israel... and also by everyone who had joined them and separated himself from the uncleanness of the peoples of the land..."

key_verse_text: And they kept the Feast of Unleavened Bread seven days with joy, for the LORD had made them joyful and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria to them, so that he aided them in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.
